text:
maria-partnerships: Hey team :wave: quick sync — we need to align on regional SKU tiering and integrator launch lanes for the next vendor waves (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Goal: a deterministic rollout plan per region that doesn’t break marketplace listing windows or SI integration timelines.

sam-eng: +1. main constraints: lab capacity per region, driver/firmware parity, and marketplace image certification.

lee-product: Can we define two lanes? lane A = press + GA in primary regions, lane B = staggered GA (no press) for secondary regions. That lowers risk for press slots. Thoughts?

nate-ops: Lane A needs reserved H100/H200 capacity in us-east and eu-west for at least 4 weeks pre-announce. Also need a canary burn to validate kernel/thermal at scale.

alia-sre: For canary, recommend 3x smaller cluster in each region with observability flags and a rollback automate job. We should also pin specific driver versions.

maria-partnerships: Proposed mapping (draft):
```
region: lane
us-east: A
eu-west: A
ap-south: B
ap-northeast: B
sa-east: B
```
This is just to start — open to moving APAC into A if lab capacity clears.

sam-eng: If we move APAC to A we need MI300 images validated on 24h long-run tests. Also GAUDI needs custom kernel 5.15+ perf patch — ops needs time to bake.

nate-ops: Agree. ETA for APAC lab availability is W+3 from now (assuming vendor hardware ship on schedule). If vendor slips, fallback is cross-region routing to us-west with latency SLAs.

lee-product: How does this affect marketplace listing sequencing? We can do a single listing with region flags, but marketing wants separate announcement pages for region A.

maria-partnerships: Marketing ask noted. Marketplace plan: publish listing, but gate the public 'availability' flag per region. marketplace.bot: New listing template v3 created: https://rdi.docs/marketplace/listing-v3 — includes regional gating fields.

alia-sre: Reminder: for Private deployments we need a separate compatibility matrix. We should not advertise GA until private runbooks are green.

sam-eng: Action items:
- sam-eng: run MI300 24h test (W+1)
- nate-ops: reserve capacity and setup canaries in us-east/eu-west (W+1)
- alia-sre: draft rollback/runbook for canary (W+1)
- maria-partnerships: coordinate vendor embargo windows and press slots (W+0.5)
- lee-product: prepare gated landing pages and region copy (W+2)

maria-partnerships: If anyone hits blockers with vendor firmware/driver we default to: delay press, move secondary regions to B lane, and surface to stakeholders. Please ping me directly with any vendor pushback. :thumbsup:

nate-ops: Noted. I'll post a short runbook once capacity is reserved and add the kernel patch checklist.

lee-product: One more ask — SI integrators need an SDK drop 48h before press for early integration. Maria can we commit to that?

maria-partnerships: Yes, commit to SDK drop 48h before press for lane A. If vendor delays SDK deliverable we'll escalate.

marketplace.bot: Reminder: embargo window rules in the template — set "embargo_end" to the announced press time to auto-toggle region flags.

sam-eng: Thanks everyone. I'll post test results and MI300 logs in this thread W+1.

maria-partnerships: Great sync — keeping this thread as the single source for lane gating decisions. If anything changes, update here and I'll update the partner stakeholders.
